tagline.en: Vodafone-owned UK MVNO — hidden UNiDAYS student free first month, 180-day keep-alive
tagline.zh: 沃达丰旗下英国虚商——UNiDAYS学生认证隐藏首月0元，180天保号

description.en: VOXI is Vodafone UK's sub-brand MVNO on Vodafone's network. Pick eSIM directly at checkout; keep-alive works like giffgaff's — any balance change (call, SMS, top-up) extends the number by 180 days, minimum top-up £5. Hidden perk: a student offer verified through UNiDAYS can land the first month free (e.g. 80GB for £10/month with month 1 free; Chinese edu emails have been reported to pass verification; UCAS and promo SIM-pack routes also appear) — cancel before day 30 to drop to PAYG.
description.zh: VOXI是沃达丰英国子品牌虚商，走Vodafone网络。下单时可直接选eSIM；保号逻辑与giffgaff相同——任意余额变动（通话、短信、充值）即延长180天，最低充值5英镑。隐藏福利：通过UNiDAYS学生认证可获首月0元（如10镑/月80GB档首月免费，国内教育邮箱也有通过案例；另有UCAS与促销SIM包入口）——临近30天时取消，之后以Paygo状态低成本保号。

details.en:
VOXI rides Vodafone UK's network (the same coverage and 5G as the parent), which makes it the cheapest clean way onto a top-tier UK network: Pay-as-you-go keep-alive needs any balance change per 180 days, minimum top-up £5, with an SMS warning ~90 days before expiry.

The documented student route: verify student status via UNiDAYS (the old £20-plan-page entry point is stale; UCAS and promo SIM-pack routes also exist) (Chinese edu addresses have been reported to pass — though at least one reviewer's attempt failed, so treat it as environment-sensitive), receive a discount code, apply it so the first month totals £0, choose eSIM, fill in personal details — the birth date you enter doubles as the PDF password protecting the eSIM QR code emailed to you — then bind a payment card and cancel before day 30 to drop to a bare PAYG keep-alive state; any activity in the following 150 days renews the 180-day window. Failed student verification just means paying normal PAYG rates — still low-cost.

Trade-offs shared with all MVNOs: data priority sits below Vodafone's own subscribers, so mainland-China roaming experience can lag the parent network; and the free-month offer is a limited-time promo that may vanish.
details.zh:
VOXI 走 Vodafone 英国网络（覆盖与 5G 规格与母公司一致），是登上英国一线网络最便宜的干净途径：Paygo 保号只需每 180 天任意一次余额变动，最低充值 5 英镑，到期前约 90 天还会收到短信提醒，不容易失手。

实测过的学生路线：通过 UNiDAYS 完成学生验证（旧的 20 英镑套餐页入口已过时，另有 UCAS 与促销 SIM 包入口；国内教育邮箱有通过案例，但也有实测失败的记录，成功与否与环境相关），获得优惠码应用后首月 0 元；随后选 eSIM、填写个人信息——注意生日同时是邮件发来的 eSIM 二维码 PDF 的密码——绑卡后在临近第 30 天时取消套餐，落到空套餐的 Paygo 保号状态，其后 150 天内再产生任意一次变动即可把 180 天窗口续满。

学生验证失败也不亏：按正常 Paygo 资费持有，成本仍然很低。

与其他虚商相同的取舍：数据优先级低于 Vodafone 本网用户，中国大陆漫游体验可能不及 Vodafone 本尊；首月免费属限时活动，可能随时下线，办理前先确认活动仍在。

bestFor.en: Budget hunters with a UNiDAYS-verifiable student account who want Vodafone-grade coverage at PAYG keep-alive cost.
bestFor.zh: 有可过UNiDAYS验证的学生账号、想以Paygo保号成本用上沃达丰级别网络的性价比用户。

note.en: VOXI is powered by Vodafone UK's network and core. A motorhome forum thread verified that Vodafone UK SIMs roaming in Portugal keep a UK IP (iPlayer streaming worked); an editorial eSIM guide also lists VOXI among UK networks giving a UK IP abroad.
note.zh: VOXI 用 Vodafone 英国网与核心网。房车论坛帖子实测 Vodafone UK 在葡萄牙漫游仍为英国 IP（iPlayer 可用），另有 eSIM 指南把 VOXI 列为漫游给英国 IP 的运营商。
